name: Pandor Artisan Bakery & Cafe
tagline: Authentic French viennoiseries, slow-fermented sourdoughs, and artisan crepes
description: Bringing the romance and mastery of a Parisian boulangerie to Old Towne Orange. Pandor bakes fresh batches of pain au chocolat, delicate fruit tarts, macarons, and authentic baguettes every dawn using traditional French baking techniques and imported flours.
historicNote: Situated right along North Glassell steps from the Plaza fountain in a classic 1910 storefront with sidewalk cafe chairs.

specials.title: Parisian Morning Breakfast
specials.description: Classic Butter Croissant + Cappuccino or Cafe au Lait for $7.50.

specials.title: Tarte & Macaron Tuesday
specials.description: Buy any signature fruit tart or éclair and receive 2 complimentary Parisian macarons.

specials.title: Artisan Bread Wednesday
specials.description: Buy one freshly baked country sourdough or olive baguette, get second loaf 50% off.

specials.title: Savory Crepe Lunch Special
specials.description: Ham, Gruyère & egg buckwheat crepe served with petite green salad and iced tea for $14.

specials.title: Afternoon Tea & Pastry
specials.description: Organic hot tea pot + choice of almond croissant or lemon meringue tart for $8.50.

specials.title: Weekend Brioche French Toast
specials.description: Thick-cut house brioche dipped in vanilla custard, served with fresh strawberries and pure maple syrup.

specials.title: Sunday Family Pastry Box
specials.description: Box of 6 assorted artisan pastries (2 croissants, 2 pain au chocolat, 2 fruit danishes) for $22.

researchMetadata.verificationNotes: Authentic French viennoiserie, morning coffee pairing, and artisanal sourdough verified.
